Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Textured Subtle Bohemian Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Grey and White Multicolor
Materials: stone
Bring a sense of bohemian luxury into your home with this fashionable rug. The muted hues emphasize the beautiful diamond pattern, and the textured shapes make this rug soft and irresistible. 4' x 6' 79% wool, 21% cotton Preserving the global craft tradition, this beautifully textured rug is handcrafted by Craftmark-certified artisans. Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
